messages:
Nora Patel: Morning folks 1 Nora here, starting as Product Designer. Quick blocker: my Figma invite says "Access restricted" even after accepting. Who do I ping for org-level SSO?
Devon Reese: Welcome Nora! :tada: Tagging @Maya (DesignOps). Maya 
can you check SCIM groups?
Maya Chen: Hey Nora :wave: usually that means you accepted with a personal account. Can you confirm the email you used? If so I'll revoke and resend to your @redwood.com. Incognito often helps as a temporary fix.
Nora Patel: I used nora.patel@gmail.com initially. Incognito showed the file but then asked for org access.
Maya Chen: Ok I removed the personal invite and resent to nora.patel@redwood.com. You should get the SSO invite in a minute. Also invited you to the Figma org team and #design-system.
Nora Patel: Got it and accepted 1 I can open "Product exploration - Nora" and the UI kit now. Thank you!
Devon Reese: For your first week, grab the Research Sprint checklist in Notion: Product > Playbooks > Research Sprints. It has interview guide, consent language, and a recruiter contact.
Nora Patel: Perfect. Do we put interview consent language in the Notion doc or inside Figma notes? I prefer having it linked in both.
Maya Chen: We keep canonical consent in Notion and paste a short consent snippet into the Figma Handoff page for visibility. I'll DM you the Handoff template and the quick checklist we use for dev handoffs.
designops-bot: :white_check_mark: Welcome package: Nora Patel added to Product Designers group, Figma org invite confirmed. Action items created: device setup, security training, join #design-system.
Oliver Grant: Hi Nora, welcome! If you'd like a buddy for your first interviews I can sit in. Also we maintain a short mapping of roadmap docs in Notion -> Product / Roadmap Links.
Nora Patel: Thanks everyone, I'll finish the onboarding checklist and schedule a 1:1 with Oliver for research pairing.
